Method of Attack: Allows remote attacker to upload additional files to compromised server
Allows attacker to gain full access to WordPress site to steal data or install additional malicious code
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Elementor Pro plugin with WooCommerce module
Attack Vector: Exploitation of broken access control vulnerability in Elementor Pro WooCommerce module via AJAX action 'pro_woocommerce_update_page_option'
Requires WooCommerce plugin installed to activate vulnerable module
Indicators of Compromise: Backdoor files named lll.zip, wp-resortpark.zip, wp-rate.php
Version: v3.11.6 and all versions before it
